model.name: Task 37.4.2: CONTROLLER single transition entry (statusNext) — guard + evidence-precondition + tick-checklist + DERIVE + persist + emit
model.description: C4.2 (subtask of T-C4, MVC decomposition; architect shape 34ae87486). The CONTROLLER (task-fsm.ts) exists — 7 states + TRANSITIONS + guards — but is unwired: six separate start* calls, no single advance, not wired to persistence. C4.2 = ONE advance entry point statusNext that moves a task to the next LEGAL state via the existing TRANSITIONS table, TICKS the checklist and lets deriveStatusEnum produce the status (NEVER hand-sets the enum), PERSISTS via the ScenarioIndex.put path, and REFUSES to advance past a step whose evidence is absent (evidence-precondition — a box ticked without evidence corrupts the exact signal Tron steers QA by). This is the PREVENTION half (records progress at the moment it happens); the checklist-chain-audit detector is the AUDIT backstop (C4.7). Ride the existing FSM, do NOT rebuild it. Family: under-recorded-progress / silent-drift.
